snapshot.text: Public system with free primary care, launching a medium-term health budget and revised national healthcare standards in 2026. Zambia agreed to sign a $1.5 billion health pact with the US after resolving differences over data sharing.

priorities.title: US health pact
priorities.text: A $1.5 billion bilateral health agreement with the US, after a dispute over data sharing.

priorities.title: Medium-term health budget
priorities.text: The government launched a medium-term budget for the health sector.

priorities.title: National healthcare standards
priorities.text: Revised national healthcare standards were introduced in 2026.
